newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fina to open new U.S. polypropylene plant.
newsitem.headline: Fina to open new U.S. polypropylene plant.

text.p: Fina Inc said on Tuesday it would build a 250,000 tonnes per year capacity polypropylene production line at its La Porte, Texas plant, taking the company's total capacity to 975,000 tonnes a year.
The new production line, Train 9, will come on stream in the third quarter of 1998, Fina's parent PetroFina said in a statement issued in Brussels.
La Porte is the biggest polypropylene plant in the world, and the addition of the new production line will make Fina the second largest producer in the United States, the statement added.
Polypropylene is a plastic used widely in home furnishings, food, cosmetics and medical appliance packaging as well as housewares, toys and car parts.
The company did not say how much the new production line would cost.
